items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Now this band with Victor Spencer, what I was in, they had Bunk playing trumpet

ctx.x: But being the floor walker he'd know who was talking every time.

But he wasn't a floor walker of rain, he lived in the crowd. But he got up just like around the corner and come around here and tell me, say don't go over there tonight, because this particular guy that committed the crime just had got out of jail and knew that, see, Evanne, daddy was one of them old old doctors. He had a lot of little funny houses painted, white trim with blue and it looked like he took blue and made it to blue, you understand? And Evanne had a really nice place. He had went to Tuskegee, he was…
